## `client.workflow`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.workflow.WorkflowManager`.

Workflow state and transitions (`@workflow`).

### `client.workflow.get`

Current state, history and available transitions of an item.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.workflow.WorkflowManager.get`.

Calls `GET /news/release-party/@workflow` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/workflow.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.workflow.get("/news/release-party")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client workflow /news/release-party -f state,transitions
```

```json
{
  "state": {
    "id": "private",
    "title": "Private"
  },
  "transitions": [
    "publish",
    "submit"
  ]
}
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/news/release-party/@workflow HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/release-party/@workflow -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "state": {
    "id": "private",
    "title": "Private"
  },
  "transitions": [
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-party/@workflow/publish",
      "title": "Publish"
    },
    {
      "@id": "http://localhost:8080/Plone/news/release-party/@workflow/submit",
      "title": "Submit for publication"
    }
  ]
}
```

This shows only `state`, `transitions`. This shows only `@id`, `title` of each entry.

### `client.workflow.transition`

Run a workflow transition.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.workflow.WorkflowManager.transition`.

Calls `POST /news/release-party/@workflow/publish` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/workflow.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.workflow.transition(
    "/news/release-party",
    "publish",
    comment="Ready for readers.",
)
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client workflow /news/release-party publish
```

```json
{
  "action": "publish",
  "actor": "admin",
  "comments": "",
  "review_state": "published",
  "time": "2026-11-01T02:47:40+00:00",
  "title": "Published"
}
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/news/release-party/@workflow/publish HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=

{
  "comment": "Ready for readers."
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/news/release-party/@workflow/publish -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"comment":"Ready for readers."}'
```
````
`````

```json

  "action": "publish",
  "comments": "Ready for readers.",
  "review_state": "published",
  "title": "Published"
}
```

This shows only `action`, `comments`, `review_state`, `title`.
